title: Agent report
description: data of: ty agent-report [--days N] --json (agentlog.py). The decision record summed up: what Claude and its agents ran, how many hardware commands came without the person speaking since the last, what each skill and agent did, and what the safety hooks refused.

hardware_without_the_person_speaking_fir.description: Hardware commands with authorisation.present false: no word from the person since the last one, or run by an agent.

refused.description: Refusals by the rule that made them.
